# #1694: Patch: the fuzz's forged probes cover the declared choices on plays, activations and the mulligan
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

The fuzz already sends malformed prompt answers to prove the engine refuses them — but the other declared choices a client sends are never forged: a target a card wasn't offered, a tribute it doesn't control, an out-of-range X, a zone it can't use, a mulligan keep it wasn't dealt. A bug that accepted one would let a forged client cheat, and today's fuzz couldn't see it. After this, those fields are perturbed to impossible values and asserted refused with the state untouched.

## Why

- `malformed_answers` (`crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`, #1574) only perturbs `ActionBody::Answer` and skips the mulligan; `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`'s probe set is reused-nonce, wrong-seat and malformed answers — nothing perturbs a choice field of a listed action.
- `Play{zone,x,tributes,targets,modes,plague,face_down}`, `Activate{ability,targets,modes,tributes}`, `ActivatePower{targets}` and `Mulligan{keep}` (`crates/engine/src/wire/actions.rs`) are refused by `why_choices_refused`, `why_x_refused`, `why_face_down_refused`, `why_declared_choices_refused` (`play_choices.rs`), `why_activate_refused` (`subsystems/activate.rs`) and `why_mulligan_refused` (`setup.rs`) — none probed; R90's bound lists only a slice of the legal combinations.
- `judge_probe` already asserts 'refused, no events, state unchanged' and is reusable.

## Proposal

Add `malformed_actions(state, chosen)` in the testkit beside `malformed_answers`: perturb one field of a listed body to an always-invalid value (`UNOFFERED_INSTANCE_ID`-style sentinels, out-of-range `x`, unoffered zone/ability, a tribute naming an enemy or nonexistent card, an undealt keep), plus a setup-window probe sending a second mulligan answer from a seat that already answered. Wire into `probe_state` with named probe constants and failure messages identifying the probe and step.

## Where it lands

`crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`, `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`. Spec §10.6, R81, R90.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Forged Play/Activate/ActivatePower/Mulligan bodies are generated and every one is refused, no events, state unchanged.
- [ ] Perturbations are impossible by construction — never plausibly legal — so no seed fails spuriously.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` and `cargo test -p jackioh-engine -p jackioh-tools` green.

## Size and risks

Medium, ~250 lines. The only real risk is an accidentally-legal perturbation — mitigated by using impossible values; mulligan probes need the `mulligan_owed` window.
